subject.title: feat(setup): offer native Windows and WSL gateway modes

question: After the availability defect is fixed, should native Windows gateway mode ship now as an explicit lower-isolation option while WSL 2 remains the recommended safest setup?
rationale: Code review can verify ownership checks and repair lifecycle supervision, but only maintainers can accept the product boundary of downloading an installer and running the gateway directly in the Windows user context before separate containment work lands.

options.title: Ship as explicit opt-in
options.body: Merge after continuous crash recovery and exact-head upgrade proof are complete, keeping WSL recommended and native clearly described as lower isolation.

options.title: Gate as experimental
options.body: Expose native mode only through an advanced or experimental affordance while gathering more containment and reliability evidence.

options.title: Hold for containment
options.body: Pause native mode until a Windows containment policy is available and validated.

recommendation.title: Ship as explicit opt-in
recommendation.body: Merge after continuous crash recovery and exact-head upgrade proof are complete, keeping WSL recommended and native clearly described as lower isolation.

likelyOwner.reason: They supplied the detailed safety and parity assessment and authored the current-head security framing and lifecycle changes.
